skills.name: craft-park
skills.description: Use when capturing a quick thought, side idea, refactor note, or non-blocking follow-up mid-flow without losing focus, or when listing, promoting, dropping, or reviewing parked wisps. Not for investigating bugs (use craft-debug) or shaping specs into epics and stories (use craft-shape).

skills.name: craft-debug
skills.description: Use when encountering a bug, test failure, regression, or unexpected behavior that needs root-cause investigation before deciding whether to fix inline, queue as a bug bead, or shape into an epic. Not for parking feature ideas (use craft-park) or building planned stories (use craft-build).

skills.name: craft-shape
skills.description: Use when turning a feature request, rough idea, promoted wisp, or design document into a specification, epic, and thin vertical-slice stories in beads. Not for mid-flow quick thoughts (use craft-park), bug root-cause diagnosis (use craft-debug), or implementing ready stories (use craft-build).

skills.name: craft-build
skills.description: Use when picking what to work on next, or when starting, resuming, or implementing a beads story or epic. Not for shaping new specs into stories (use craft-shape) or diagnosing unknown bug root causes (use craft-debug).

commands.name: craft-park
commands.description: Park an idea as a wisp, or list, promote, and drop items. [idea|list|promote|drop|review] [--priority 0-4]

commands.name: craft-debug
commands.description: Investigate a bug symptom or issue in a diagnostic wisp. [symptom-or-id] [--task <id>]

commands.name: craft-shape
commands.description: Shape an idea or spec into an epic and thin stories. [feature-or-spec] [--with egm|superpowers|grill-me] [--dry-run]

commands.name: craft-build
commands.description: Build or resume a beads story or epic. [story-id|epic-id] [--auto] [--no-commit]

agents.description: Executes batched bd CLI commands to create an epic, thin vertical-slice stories with --spec-id pointers, swimlane labels, and dependencies from an approved craft-shape plan.
